ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent that inspects community-submitted bug reports, writes patches, and opens verified pull requests for open-source repositories.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world open-source and community challenges from FOSS Forge 2.0 challenge pool.
ideas.title: OpenSourcePR-Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets open-source maintainers' biggest bottlenecks, aligning with FOSS Forge 2.0's core ethos of contributing to real open-source projects.

ideas.pitch: A data engineering sync tool and automated incident response agent for non-profit organizations to manage donor records and campaign metrics securely.
ideas.problem_statement: Tools that non-profit organizations currently need from the FOSS Forge 2.0 challenge pool.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an urgent operational burden for non-profits with a working, production-ready demo that judges from community organizations can immediately test.
